observed_response.question: Who coordinates North Roof settling, and how long does a bucket stay still?
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

North Roof honey settling is coordinated by Petra Noll. For each batch, strain through the coarse sieve, close the settling lid, then enter the batch weight in the harvest ledger. Keep the covered bucket still for 24 hours before filling jars. The batch cap is 20 kg; do not combine harvest dates in one bucket. Buckets now stand on the east bench. The ground-level teaching hive uses 8 kg buckets and is managed separately. This note records processing quantities, not selling prices. [1]

observed_response.question: Give reception the sequence for an arriving Cedar radio guest.
observed_response.answer:
Source extracts (not model-generated):

Amina Vale handles guest arrivals at Cedar radio. Guests arrive 20 minutes before airtime. Reception first checks the guest name against the running sheet, next issues a visitor slip, and finally calls the segment producer. Up to 3 guests may join one segment. Do not announce a guest's personal phone number on air. Blank visitor slips are in tray 5. A remote interview may have 6 callers; callers do not receive visitor slips. [1]

Cedar community interviews air at 14:20 on Tuesdays. In-studio guests enter through the courtyard door. During the December festival, community interviews air at 13:20 instead. Remote interviews keep their own running sheets. [2]
